title: Value of a binary suffix
statement: For every finite Boolean word $w$ and every $j\in\mathbb{N}$, the value of the suffix obtained by deleting the first $j$ bits of $w$ is at most the value of $w$, where the value is computed with the first bit as the least significant bit.
